events.title: BCRA second-quarter monetary-policy presentation
events.summary: BCRA reaffirmed its fiscal and monetary inflation anchor. It reported USD 13,337 million in FX purchases through July 31. These are reported past purchases, not an FX forecast.
events.publicationNote: Source dated August 6; exact clock unavailable. Conservatively usable after end of Argentina local day.

events.title: BCRA August monetary report
events.summary: Private transactional M2 was stable in real seasonally adjusted terms. Monetary base rose 1.5% on that basis; private peso lending fell 1.0%.
events.publicationNote: Source dated September 7; next local day used because exact publication clock is unavailable.

events.title: BCRA REM August 2026, released September 4
events.summary: 47 participants. Median monthly average wholesale USD forecasts: September 1530.397708358 ARS/USD, October 1565. September expected CPI 1.8% monthly. Expected September TAMAR 24.11% nominal annual is a bank deposit rate, not a policy rate.
events.publicationNote: Release date verified on BCRA publication page. XLSX first worksheet: FX B52/D52 and B53/D53; CPI D8; TAMAR D39. Exact clock unavailable: next Argentina local day used.

events.title: Observed official fiat FX proxy for ARS
events.summary: Last published price 1510 local currency per USD. This is an official fiat proxy, not a Twin token executable price.

events.title: INDEC August 2026 CPI
events.summary: National CPI rose 1.7% monthly and 33.5% year-on-year in August 2026.
events.publicationNote: September 10 release date verified at INDEC Nivel4/Tema/3/5/31; PDF page 3. Conservatively next local day; absent from September 6 pack.
